tenderSchedule.title: PC-1496 Call-2 Establishment of transformer repair centre at Kalaburagi and carrying out repairs to faulty 250 KVA and 500 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 250 KVA and 500 KVA star rated (star rated 3/4/5) Distribution Transformers
tenderSchedule.description: PC-1496 Call-2 Establishment of transformer repair centre at Kalaburagi and carrying out repairs to faulty 250 KVA and 500 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 250 KVA and 500 KVA star rated (star rated 3/4/5) Distribution Transformers
tenderSchedule.locationName: GESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Gulbarga

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The scope of work covers collection of faulty 250 KVA and 500 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 250 KVA and 500 KVA star rated (star rated 3/4/5) Distribution Transformers from concerned O&M zonal stores/ Headquarters, dismantling of Transformer HT and LT coils from the core and damaging all the HT and LT coils with cutter at the concerned divisional stores in the presence of store keeper and the concerned O&M divisional Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele), Transformer Repair Monitoring. Lifting the damaged coils by the repairer and shall be kept with the repairer. The released oil to be retained at the concerned GESCOM store. Collection of Transformer tank with core from the stores, repairing of the Transformer by providing HT and LT winding by new coils, Bushing rods, metal parts, Lamination (CRGO) HT/LT Bushing insulators, Washers, Gasket, repairs of the Tank, Painting etc., drying the repaired winding in the Oven as required, filling up with new EHV grade Transformer oil as per relevant IS (providing new transformer oil is in the scope of repairer) and testing repaired good Transformer at the repair center. Testing of repaired good Transformer at divisional automatic test bench of GESCOM to ensure the quality of repaired good transformers as per GESCOM specifications by the Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele), Transformer Repair Monitoring and handing over to the concerned divisional stores. The faulty Transformers received from respective store shall be repaired and returned to the same stores. The purchase order for repairing the above faulty distribution transformers and returning the repaired good distribution transformers shall be placed by the respective O&M CEEs of the concerned O&M Zone GESCOM. Note: The new transformer oil supplied and filled by the repairer shall be in accordance with the relevant Indian Standards.
EMD: Rs. 4,24,670/- (Rs. Four Lakhs Twenty Four Thousand Six Hundred and Seventy only) as per KPP portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should possess statutory certificates such as UDYAM/DIC/ SSI/MSME issued by Govt. of Karnataka /India for manufacturing/repair of distribution transformers or repair of any electrical equipments. Documents to this effect shall be uploaded.

The Bidder shall upload self-declaration of having Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering or else employ 1(one) number of qualified person who have Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering to supervise the process of repair works. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall be capable of repairing minimum 20 Nos. of transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) per month and shall be capable for setting up necessary infrastructure at the location as per the scope of the work for repairs within 30 days from the date of awarding the work and submit the necessary statutory clearance certificate/ authorization letters from concerned authority i.e Karnataka State Pollution Control Board for the newly established repair Centre within 90 days from the date of issuance of LOI failing to which GESCOM reserves the right to cancel the DWA. Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall possess the registration of EPF, ESI, GST, labour license certificate (form-C for establishment) and PAN card issued by the respective competent authorities of the concerned department. The copy of original registration documents shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall agree to install web based CCTV cameras at his own cost as per the GESCOM requirement for monitoring of all the activities in the repair center by the GESCOM, within 30 days from the date of award. The video footage shall be preserved by the bidder and also it is to be presented as and when requested by the GESCOM authorities.Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.

In case of manufacturer, the bidder must have manufactured and supplied minimum of 240 Nos. of Distribution Transformers (of 250 KVA or higher capacities/ratings in total) to ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India /Total Turnkey/ Partial Turnkey works during the Five financial years put together (i.e., 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25). OR In case of repairer, the bidder should have repaired a minimum of 120 Nos Distribution Transformers (of 250 KVA or higher capacities/ratings in total) in any ESCOM of Karnataka in any one year of the Five financial years (i.e., 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: Work experience of major repairs carried out to faulty transformers will be considered. Minor repair works will not be considered. In case of Manufacturer: As a proof, copy of the order completion certificate for having supplied 240 Nos of Distribution Transformers (of any capacities /ratings in total) against the purchase orders/Award issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning PO/Award No. date and quantity and financial year of supply shall be scanned and uploaded. OR In case of repairer,As a proof, copy of the order completion certificate having repaired 120 numbers of Distribution Transformers duly mentioning Award No/ PO number and date, quantity repaired, financial year of repair issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs in Karnataka shall be scanned and uploaded.

For the above, Financial year wise (i.e., 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India shall be scanned and uploaded. Failure of Distribution Transformers within guarantee period should not exceed 6%. Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning the number of Transformers supplied (for manufacturer)/ Repaired (for repairer), Failed within guarantee period(WGP) and percentage of failure within guarantee period shall be scanned and uploaded

The bidder shall purchase the DPC wire and any other materials required etc., as per IS specifications from manufacturer /authorized dealers only in the name of bidder. Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidder should not have been Black-Listed/short closed/terminated from his contract due to non-performance in execution of works against the order placed by ESCOMs/KPTCL/any other Government Distribution/Transmission utilities including PSUs as on date of bid submission. Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with /KPTCL/ESCOMS. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part may result in rejection of bid. Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.

The Average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than the 50% of the amount put to tender during the last 3 financial years i.e 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. The audited balance sheets (including profit and loss account sheet) for the said financial years signed by CAs with UDIN and by the authorized signatory of the firm shall be scanned and uploaded.

The bidders shall upload Liquid assets (Cash at Bank +Term deposit in any Nationalized/Scheduled Commercial Bank) on or after the date of notification of tender + Availability of credit facility in any Nationalized/Scheduled Commercial Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender which shall be supported by certificate issued by any Nationalized /Scheduled Commercial Bank. The said Credit Facility Certificate should possess the name of the Firm and tender Indent number and the credit facility to be issued in the Format Annexed to this bid ANNEXURE-A. The conditional credit certificates are liable for rejection. Documents to this effect shall be uploaded.
The successful bidder shall establish the repair shed with required power supply at their own cost. Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.
